sections.heading: Key timings

items.text: Guests arrive at Great Malvern Priory
Welcome drinks and canapés at the hall

sections.note: Please make your way directly to the reception venue after the service.

sections.heading: Venues & travel
sections.note: Please allow time for travel and parking between venues. Guests should travel directly to the hall after the service.

items.heading: Food
body: Welcome drinks and canapés will be served from 2:00 pm. A buffet meal will begin from 3:00 pm.

items.heading: Seating
body: Seating at the reception will be informal. Please choose any available table, except tables marked Reserved

items.heading: Children
body: Children are warmly invited. Parents are kindly asked to supervise them throughout the day.

sections.heading: Gifts & final notes
body: Your presence at our wedding is the greatest gift to us. For those who have kindly asked, we have created a wedding gift list.

sections.heading: Photography
body: We would love you to help us capture the day through your eyes!

During the reception, visit our Photo Guestbook table, take an instant photo of yourselves, or anything you would like for us to remember. Stick it into our wedding scrapbook and leave us a message, piece of advice or a memory.
Funny, beautiful, unexpected — we want them all. 🤍
sections.tagline: Snap it • Stick it • Sign it

sections.heading: We cannot wait to celebrate with you.
